draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) suggest that salience pre-filtering may help reduce unsupported entities in summaries.
rationale: P1 (Varga & Sandoval 2021) describes the salience pre-filtering method but says nothing about unsupported entities or hallucination reduction. The 30% reduction claim in the methods summary is not attributed to P1, and no test supports it. The claim attributes to the cited work a statement it does not make.
